title: Rabbi Chiyya bar Ami
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as Ulla’s student who always spoke in Ulla’s name, as in [Berakhot 8a:18-19](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.8a.18-19), [Shabbat 17b:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.17b.3), [Shabbat 79a:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.79a.8) and 110a (in [Gittin 22a:15](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.22a.15), “Rabbi Chiyya bar Assi said in Ulla’s name,” and Hyman proposes bar Ami), [Bava Batra 163a:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.163a.5), [Sanhedrin 26a:15](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.26a.15) [according to Dikdukei Soferim] and [Avodah Zarah 37a:13-14](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.37a.13-14). Hyman cites Avodah Zarah 23b for this scene: “Rav Nachman, Ulla and Avimi bar Pappi were sitting, and Rabbi Chiyya bar Ami was sitting with them.” In [Chagigah 25b:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Chagigah.25b.8), “Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba in Ulla’s name: A beit peras that was trodden is pure” — [Tosafot on Bekhorot 29b:1:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Bekhorot.29b.1.1) read Rabbi Chiyya bar Ami. In [Arakhin 28b:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Arakhin.28b.4) he spoke in the name of Cholfana (or Ulpana).[^4]

Well known is the saying cited in his name in several places: “His betrothed wife — he is not an onen and does not become impure for her,” etc. Hyman traces it to [Ketubot 53a:13-14](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.53a.13-14), where he said to Rav Nachman, Ulla and Avimi bar Pappi: “We have learned: His betrothed wife,” etc. From this it is cited in [Bava Metzia 18a:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.18a.2) with the formula “from what he taught,” and in [Yevamot 43b:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.43b.8) “but did he not teach?” In [Sanhedrin 28b:11](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.28b.11) Hyman regards as an error the reading “as Rabbi Chiyya bar Ami said in Ulla’s name”; he proposes “as it was recited in a baraita.” In [Yevamot 29b:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.29b.8) the words “bar Ami” are missing; in [Ketubot 89b:12](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.89b.12), “as Rabbi Chiyya bar Avin taught,” Hyman proposes bar Ami; and Hyman cites Sanhedrin 43b for Rabbi Chiyya bar Ashi speaking in the name of Rav Chisda and reports that Dikdukei Soferim reads Rabbi Chiyya bar Ami.

notes.text: Chiyya is the student reporting Ulla, not Ulla reporting Chiyya. The supplied Avodah Zarah23b locator remains alongside the earlier parallel-notice53b comparison, without a fresh matching-locus claim here. All Assi/Ami/Abba/Avin/Ashi and reciter/transmission corrections remain Hyman’s proposals.

Ketubot 53a directly names Nachman, Ulla, Avimi bar Rav Pappi and Chiyya bar Ami in the sitting scene and the betrothed-wife baraita. Bounded normalized-name checks of the consulted Avodah Zarah 23b and 53b did not match that scene; these checks are not claims of absence. Hyman’s supplied locator, name corrections and reciter-versus-transmitter emendations are retained with this qualification.

The consulted folio has the parallel at [Sanhedrin 43a:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.43a.10), with Rav Chiyya bar Rav Ashi citing Rav Chisda. Hyman’s 43b and his reported Dikdukei Soferim variant are retained.

The Hebrew of [Gittin 22a:15](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.22a.15) reads Chiyya bar Assi, while the accompanying English gives Chiyya bar Ami. [Shabbat 79a:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.79a.8) reads Chiyya bar Ami in the same teaching about three stages of preparing hides. [Sanhedrin 26a:15](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.26a.15) gives Rav Chiyya without a patronymic. The locust discussion continues at [Avodah Zarah 37b:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.37b.1). [Tosafot on Bekhorot 29b:1:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Bekhorot.29b.1.1) quotes the teaching in [Chagigah 25b:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Chagigah.25b.8) as Rav Chiyya bar Rabbi Ami; the consulted Chagigah text has Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba. The sitting scene occurs at [Ketubot 53a:13-14](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.53a.13-14), where Chiyya recites the teaching about a betrothed wife. [Sanhedrin 28b:11](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.28b.11) expressly gives his citation in Ulla’s name. [Yevamot 29b:8](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.29b.8) says Rabbi Chiyya, and [Ketubot 89b:12](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.89b.12) says Rav Chiyya bar Avin. [Sanhedrin 43a:10](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.43a.10) gives Rav Chiyya bar Rav Ashi citing Rav Chisda.
